newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Saab Auto ups US car sales target.
newsitem.headline: Saab Auto ups US car sales target.

text.p: Saab Automobile has a sales target of 28,000 cars in the United States this calendar year compared with 25,500 in 1995, managing director Robert Hendry told journalists after a breakfast meeting on Tuesday.
He said the global sales target for this year was 100,000 cars, which compared with 98,700 in 1995.
Saab has just launched a leasing programme in the U.S., the lack of which was said to have caused a slide of 37 percent in car sales in October against the same month of 1995.
Hendry said September sales had been strong, and that sales so far this year were six percent up on the same period last year.
He reiterated Saab's ambition to push sales to 150,000 a year by the year 2000.
